map.算单位体积储存的弹性能: Elastic energy stored per unit volume
map.U = sigma^2/(2E) = 1/2 * sigma * epsilon: U = sigma^2/(2E) = 1/2 * sigma * epsilon. Steel under 200 MPa with E = 200 GPa: U = 200e6^2/(2*200e9) = 100 J/m³. Fully released on unloading.
map.E 大储能密度低（硬而脆储不了多少）；橡胶 E 小但可大变形，总储能可观。: A large E gives low energy density (hard and brittle stores little); rubber has small E but large deformation, so total storage is significant.
map.线性弹性应力随应变线性增，平均应力为峰值一半，能量=平均应力*应变=sigma^: In linear elasticity stress rises linearly with strain, average stress is half the peak, energy = average stress × strain = sigma^2/(2E).
map.弹性能和塑性功区别？: What is the difference between elastic energy and plastic work?
map.弹性能在卸载时完全释放（可逆），塑性功转为热与缺陷（不可逆）；冲击吸能设计要分清: Elastic energy is fully released on unloading (reversible), while plastic work turns into heat and defects (irreversible); impact energy-absorption design must distinguish them.
